{%- comment -%}
The index for language models (https://llmstxt.org). Jekyll builds it from
`_config.yml` and the games in `_games/`, the same files the pages are drawn
from, so a game added or released shows here on the next build. An unreleased
game carries what its home-page banner shows and no page.
{%- endcomment -%}
{%- assign games = site.games | sort: "order" -%}
{%- assign about = site.pages | where: "path", "about.md" | first -%}
{%- assign privacy = site.pages | where: "path", "privacy.md" | first -%}
# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description | strip_newlines | strip }}

{{ site.title }} is the game studio of the research physicist {{ site.founder.name }}.
Its work so far is {% for game in games %}{% if forloop.last %}and {% endif %}{{ game.title }}{% unless forloop.last %}, {% endunless %}{% endfor %}, and each one starts from real physics.

Use of this material:
{% include use-of-material.md %}
## Games

- [Games as JSON]({{ '/data/games.json' | absolute_url }}): Every game with its tagline, platforms, release, page, press kit and App Store link.
{%- for game in games %}
{%- if game.released %}
- [{{ game.title }}]({{ game.url | absolute_url }}): {{ game.tagline | replace: '&nbsp;', ' ' }} {{ game.description | default: game.teaser }}
{%- if game.appstore_url %}
- [{{ game.title }} on the App Store]({{ game.appstore_url }})
{%- endif %}
{%- else %}
{%- capture summary %}{{ game.tagline }} {{ game.teaser }} {{ game.release_note }}.{% endcapture %}
- [{{ game.title }}]({{ '/#games' | absolute_url }}): {{ summary | replace: '&nbsp;', ' ' | split: ' ' | join: ' ' }}
{%- endif %}
{%- endfor %}
